verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's Delaware Incorporation Package generates a Restricted Stock Purchase Agreement and, when stock is subject to vesting, adds a Form of Section 83(b) Election, Joint Escrow Instructions and a Stock Assignment. A community post independently confirms Cooley GO has posts on allocating initial founder equity and on equity incentive tax issues. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of co-founder equity-split guidance (only community-attested), detail on vesting schedule terms (cliffs, acceleration), and any coverage of non-US equivalents of the 83(b) election.
